integrity: The general threshold is proved from the image of zero; the finite \(9\)-to-\(27\) count is independently exhausted by the supplied verifier. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The general result is a correction of the lower valuation threshold in arXiv:2610.02393v1. The exact cardinality \(19\) is claimed only for the explicit map set from the multiplicative monoid of \(\mathbb Z/9\mathbb Z\) to that of \(\mathbb Z/27\mathbb Z\). Later revisions of the source may incorporate the same correction.
title: Ceiling threshold for prime-power multiplicative monoid morphisms
